summary:
quality lens over backend-observability (11 product path(s), a40b7a1..14ca9d6, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 0 blocking, 5 non-blocking. VERDICT t9-c1: partial — backend/src/common/global-exception.filter.ts:74 misclassifies every HTTP 400 as validation, and stack sanitization is incomplete
VERDICT t9-c2: partial — backend/src/main.ts:26 places request logging after short-circuiting CORS handling, while backend/src/common/request-logging.middleware.ts:31 logs unmasked paths
VERDICT t9-c3: implemented — backend/src/common/error-envelope.wiring.test.ts:27 invokes configureApp before app.init at line 28
The filter and logging components are present and wired through the intended seam, and the wiring tests are allow-listed. However, the missing preflight coverage, incorrect 400 classification, and concrete stack/PII disclosure paths leave the observability contracts only partially implemented.

blocking_findings.summary: t9-c1: a global exception filter (constitution 07) maps every unhandled exception and existing HttpException to the full standard error payload (errorId, type, user-facing message, sanitized details, http status, correlationId, requestId, environment, timestampUtc) and is wired app-wide via useGlobalFilters

t9-c2: structured JSON logging (constitution 05 §2.1) emits a request record and, on error, a distinct error record, each carrying timestampUtc/level/message/context/environment/serviceName/module/correlationId/accountId/requestId; correlationId accepts a valid inbound x-correlation-id else generates a UUID at ingress

non_blocking_findings.summary: Blank ENVIRONMENT values expose Local-only stack traces (backend/src/config.ts:128): The required fallback is `ENVIRONMENT || nodeEnv`, but `??` treats an empty `ENVIRONMENT` as configured.
Install request logging before the CORS middleware (backend/src/main.ts:26): `enableCors()` installs the CORS middleware before `requestLogging`.
Do not log unmasked client-controlled request paths (backend/src/common/request-logging.middleware.ts:31): The request record copies `req.path` directly into structured context.

Distinguish validation failures from other HTTP 400 exceptions (backend/src/common/global-exception.filter.ts:74): `validationDetails` classifies every 400 `HttpException` as validation and always returns a fallback field error.
Actually sanitize stack content before logging or returning it (backend/src/common/structured.logger.ts:51): `sanitizedStack` only removes the first line and returns everything else verbatim.
